description: Centri di Attesa, Ammassamento e Ricovero in Emergenza di Protezione Civile_Aree Emergenza is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. The map shows the Rescue and Resources Massing Areas, the Population Retention Areas, the Population Waiting Areas according to the “Guidelines for Municipal Civil Protection Planning (Ligurian Region)”. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Waiting, Massing and Rescue Centres in Civil Protection Emergency_Emergency Areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Siti protezione civile. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
